model: 國立中山大學逸仙館 — 前上磚牆與前門廊欄板限域外觀代理
scope: Independent visual and original-triangle/material review only. No main repository mutation, upload, geometry changes or physical print.

source_evidence.photo1: PARTIAL-NOT-EVIDENCE file not viewed or used
source_evidence.source_dates: No date EXIF found in the two complete images. Official captions do not establish exposure date. 2020 renovation article cannot date these photos; no 2026-current-condition claim.
source_evidence.before_comparison_note: Original preview has Warm stone preview only material. The separate same-angle neutral image is a diagnostic neutralization, not a historical photograph or original warm-material render.

visual_findings.official2: Front upper principal brick face, large shallow curved recess, red parapet over projecting white/gray portico and light columns/soffit are visible. Fine cap, lettering, brick joints and shadows are not taken as homogeneous red surface measurements.
visual_findings.official3: Opposite low front-side view independently agrees on brick versus light beam/column separation; visible side red wall has a gray base and is deliberately not colored in this package.
visual_findings.front: Brick-red limited to upper front principal plane and projecting parapet front. Curved recess reveal/backing, columns, soffit, horizontal tops, side cheeks and glazing are neutral. No new geometry or pasted imagery.
visual_findings.rear: All visible back/side/roof remains neutral; not an assertion of actual gray material.
visual_findings.elevation: Front red extent and existing curved void retained; parapet face colored but lower beam/columns and inset recess remain neutral. Fine missing coping and lettering are not reconstructed.
visual_findings.side: Neutral side wall, balcony cheek/top and roof preserved, no wraparound brick coloring.
visual_findings.top: Horizontal roof/platform/portico tops all neutral. No spurious roof or glass coloring.
visual_findings.all_five_views: Personally inspected final 1200x1200 pixels. Whole object including base remains within frame; independently projected all original vertices and confirmed clipping margin.
visual_findings.coarse_proxy_judgment: Acceptable as explicitly limited principal brick-plane proxy. Missing fine gray caps/lettering/brick joints are small unmodeled details, not grounds to invent split-face patches; no claim of precise full external skin restoration.

geometry_and_selection.selection_method: Independent oriented four-corner rectangle plane and edge-halfspace test for all three triangle vertices, with outward -Y face orientation and 0.0002mm tolerance. No centroid-only selection or builder classifier/probe import. Boundary dimensions independently checked against unchanged original generator.
geometry_and_selection.stl_and_exchange: Original seven file bytes/SHA256/Git blob checked. Work and research STL byte-identical to fixed original. 3MF XML all 3110 triangles preserve exact ordered original coordinates/winding; p1=p2=p3 for each complete triangle. Identity build and millimeter units.
geometry_and_selection.no_drift: No subdivision, added geometry or reordered original triangle assignments. 3MF materials exactly neutral #AAA79FFF and brick proxy #AE6C58FF.

limitations: Opaque #AE6C58 is an uncalibrated visual proxy, not a measured color or proof of precise material composition.
3057 neutral faces mean unconfirmed/out-of-scope color, not evidence that side/back/roof/glass are gray.
Original geometry is a coarse historical exterior study; this review does not certify hidden rear/roof/interior accuracy or improve them.
Original fine caps, letters, brick joints and stains are not modeled. No mesh splits were made to imitate them.
Source image dates and relationship to 2020 refurbishment unknown. No 2026-current-appearance assertion.
No physical print, FFF slicing or historical manufacturing-QA rerun in this appearance-only review.
builder_checks_summary: Read strict exchange/manifold + real edit-save-reopen, native triangle/winding comparison, Blend material/geometry save-reopen and independent-directory determinism reports. Independent reviewer separately recomputed STL/3MF exactness, all-face selection, original hashes and camera framing; did not claim to rerun all builder tests.
packaging: PASS applies to bound frozen files only. Final ZIP member inclusion of this report and independent checks must be checked separately when the builder supplies the package.
